report_name: WordPress patches critical RCE flaw (CVE-2026-65640) for author-level users

tools.name: Imagick
tools.description: A PHP extension used for image processing. In the context of CVE-2026-65640, it incorrectly passes specially crafted files to the Ghostscript interpreter, enabling code execution.

tools.name: Ghostscript
tools.description: A file interpreter that is called by the Imagick library to process files. It executes malicious PostScript code embedded in a disguised PNG file, leading to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-65640
vulnerabilities.description: A high-severity remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in WordPress allows authenticated users with 'Author' or higher privileges to execute arbitrary code by uploading a specially crafted PNG file containing PostScript code. The flaw is triggered on servers using the Imagick PHP extension and Ghostscript for file processing.

identities.name: WordPress
identities.description: The content management system affected by the CVE-2026-65640 remote code execution vulnerability.

indicators.name: Ghostscript Process Execution by Web Server
indicators.pattern:
title: Ghostscript Execution by Web Server
id: 2b8a7b3c-1f9e-4d6a-8c7b-9e3d1a0b2c4d
status: experimental
description: 'Detects the Ghostscript executable (''gs'') being spawned by a common web server process. This may indicate exploitation of vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-65640 in WordPress.'
references:
  - https://cybersecuritynews.com/wordpress-imagick-rce-vulnerability/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-14
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_process:
    Image|endswith: '/gs'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '/apache'
      - '/httpd'
      - 'php-fpm'
      - '/nginx'
      - 'www-data'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate web applications that use Ghostscript for file conversion.
indicators.description: Detects the Ghostscript executable ('gs') being spawned by a common web server process, which may indicate exploitation of CVE-2026-65640.

indicators.name: Ghostscript Executable Name Detection

author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-14
tags:

level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '/gs'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate execution of Ghostscript by users or other applications.
indicators.description: Detects the execution of the Ghostscript binary 'gs', which is used in the exploit chain for CVE-2026-65640.
